name: Incipience
author: saustin2010
summary: Eleven-instrument drum synth laid out like the Jomox AlphaBase Mk II (kick, MBrane, hats, clap, rim, cymbals, two sample players, 4-op FM, reverb, delay), with RANDOMISE per instrument and a mod matrix; each instrument chromatic on its own MIDI channel and on its own track with Incipience OUT; plays the AlphaBase's free samples and your own WAVs.
